honest_c3_top3: (1) FT recovers chat-cap = HYPOTHESIS, not guarantee. Prior cells64/128 + convo_5k all gibberish (sampling test 2026-05-10) — #115 architectural chat-incapability is the leading explanation. FT @ 5K-20K step on a different (but related) corpus may not move the needle if the architecture itself caps coherent KO emit. Estimated calibration: P(post-FT KO chat ≥3/5 coherent) ≈ 25-40%.

(2) Corpus format mismatch risk: convo_5k.pt was originally FT'd on '~2.5K Korean dialogue + English mixed' (per .roadmap.clm_v2_chat v2_chat_evidence). Our corpus = anima_dialogue_tier_a_iter2 with persona-tag prefix '[anima 역할: ...]'. Format drift may interfere — model could degrade on the original chat surface or learn the new persona-prefix surface only. Mitigation: optional strip of [anima 역할:] prefix before feed; or include both formats.

(3) Byte-level + 18M params is fundamentally undertrained for KO. Sampling test showed 0/64 KO chars emitted (UTF-8 multi-byte sequences require ~3 bytes per Hangul char × precise byte coordination). 5K-20K additional steps on 76MB corpus = ~76M*0.5 epoch = 38M byte gradient updates ≈ noise-floor in pre-training terms; this is FT scale (chat surface) not pre-train scale (language acquisition). If language is the gap, FT will not bridge it.
